section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants of the present study, which included a final sample of 151 individuals after one exclusion. The sample consisted primarily of female university students (72.8% females, 96.7% students) with a mean age of 23.1 years, many of whom were psychology majors. Participants received course credit or a chocolate bar for their involvement.
